{{Top}}
A '''standard decade''' (or simply called a '''decade''') was a unit of [[Time/Legends|time]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Based on the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], which was itself based upon the revolution and [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it comprised ten [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].
